test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Madhuram is an immediate neighbour of both Rahim and Amit. Sumit is sitting second to the right of Rahim. David is sitting third to the left of Amit. Prem is an immediate neighbour of both Sumit and Amit. Who is an immediate neighbour of both Madhuram and Prem ?
solution:
Six persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 

1. Madhuram is an immediate neighbour of both Rahim and Amit. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd6c05f26990953db0be1407371c10aee03ce74a27fc87e0a0d866d9d53481d1.png] 

2. Sumit is sitting second to the right of Rahim. 

3. David is sitting third to the left of Amit. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f3f9f2d87a6bbaa6110839f3b1787f3c295804214439c27d9061f6f2542957c.png] 

4. Prem is an immediate neighbour of both Sumit and Amit. 

The above condition cannot be satisfies in Case I, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ac011b37d1bedeb339cf1e9a23c149eb9afd8e16c36050107e080016d3994ba.png] 

Clearly, Amit is an immediate neighbour of both Madhuram and Prem.

Hence, ‘**Amit**’ is the correct answer.
